instruction: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.

arguments.note: Approach above the bread rack, leaving room to turn the gripper downward for an upper-edge grasp.

arguments.hindsight: Use a deeper upper-edge grasp and verify retention before transport. Plan the toaster-side arm’s reachable approach before lifting bread, and avoid bringing the wrist housing into the closely spaced rack.
arguments.reason: I could not establish a reliable bread grasp and reachable insertion path. The recovered slice slipped, and subsequent arm motions repeatedly diverged or encountered obstructions.
